name: Color Palette Builder
summary: Browser tool that builds tints, shades, tones and colour harmonies from a starter colour.
description: A free tool on Color Designer that turns a starter colour into tints, shades and tones and into harmonies such as complementary, analogous, split complementary, triadic, square and rectangular (LCH). Palettes are assembled from swatches, a colour picker, a library or a mass editor, and can be previewed over image categories like background, texture, minimal, pattern, architecture and landscape. It is one of 13 colour tools on the site.
contains: tints, shades and tones generated from a starter colour
harmonies: complementary, analogous, split complementary, triad, square, rectangle
swatches, colour picker, library and mass editor
palette previews over background, texture, minimal, pattern, architecture and landscape images
starter palettes by green, blue, red, orange, purple, yellow and gray
